decision: Do not install btree_gin. Separate indexes are sufficient for planner-selected bitmap combinations; no measured query currently demonstrates a need for mixed multicolumn GIN.
limitations: No topic/domain FTS query plan was evaluated because the canonical topic search relation is not established.
This does not prove BitmapAnd is selected or that AIO improves a workload.
WFU-07's representative EXPLAIN/pg_aios proof remains open.
